blurb: Welcome to our beautiful golf courses in Lynnfield, Massachusetts. Since our first course opened in 1931, it has been an important and valued part of the community. We do our best to honor the tradition of fine service and high quality golf with each and everything that we do here, from the service in the pro shop to the event hosting to the grounds maintenance.
